---
title: "Joint 购买效率与选组结构：统一结算报告"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  cache: false
  freeze: false
  error: false
params:
  main: null
  main_sha256: null
  structure: null
  structure_sha256: null
  labels: null
  labels_sha256: null
  catalog: null
  output: null
---

各方案使用相同冻结概率和原候选组。本金10万元，每期投入上限1024元；北单回款只在票级乘一次0.65。
分段为固定原研究窗口，最大回撤段属于事后窗口；这些回顾结果不能当作未见数据成绩。
资金曲线按期序逐期结算，不模拟同时占用多期本金。原期和新增期分组各从10万元起算，
合计曲线使用连续账户，不在分界处补充本金。金额为依据结算 SP 计算的理论税前回款。
FUNDED 是可支付账本：首次无法支付整期计划后永久停投，保留余款，不拆注、不借款。
SHADOW 是持续执行全部冻结计划的诊断账本，资金可以为负，不能视为这10万元实际可实现的收益。

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(readr);library(ggplot2)})
modules<-paste0('r/',c('n7_purchase_settle','diagnostic_verified_csv','diagnostic_verified_rds',
 'fundamentals_equity_curves','n7_purchase_accounting'),'.R')
for(f in modules)source(f)
files<-c(modules,'quarto/202_joint_purchase_report.qmd','config/top2_outside_validation.json')
code<-setNames(as.list(vapply(files,digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),files)
cfg<-jsonlite::fromJSON('config/top2_outside_validation.json')
roots<-c(params$main,params$structure);hashes<-c(params$main_sha256,params$structure_sha256)
stopifnot(length(roots)==2,length(hashes)==2,!anyNA(roots),!anyNA(hashes))
receipts<-list()
for(i in 1:2) {
 path<-file.path(roots[i],'plans-receipt.json');bytes<-readBin(path,'raw',n=file.info(path)$size)
 stopifnot(digest::digest(bytes,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==hashes[i])
 receipts[[i]]<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(bytes),simplifyVector=FALSE)
}
stopifnot(identical(receipts[[1]]$scope,receipts[[2]]$scope),
 receipts[[2]]$parent_receipt_sha256==hashes[1])
ids<-unlist(receipts[[1]]$scope)
catalog_bytes<-readBin(params$catalog,'raw',n=file.info(params$catalog)$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(catalog_bytes,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==receipts[[1]]$catalog_sha256)
catalog<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(catalog_bytes))
stopifnot(identical(catalog$issues$issue,ids),!anyDuplicated(catalog$requested_issues),
 !anyDuplicated(catalog$unavailable_issues$issue),
 !any(catalog$unavailable_issues$issue %in% ids),
 setequal(catalog$requested_issues,c(ids,catalog$unavailable_issues$issue)))
scope_table<-tibble(requested_issues=length(catalog$requested_issues),
 evaluated_issues=length(ids),unavailable_issues=nrow(catalog$unavailable_issues),
 first_issue=min(ids),last_issue=max(ids))
knitr::kable(scope_table)
knitr::kable(catalog$unavailable_issues)
labels<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(params$labels,params$labels_sha256,cols(issue='c',provider_id='c')) |>
 select(issue,slot,provider_id,handicap,actual_direction,spf_sp)
groups<-models<-list()
for(i in 1:2)for(id in ids) {
 b<-receipts[[i]]$bindings[[id]]
 plan<-diagnostic_read_verified_rds(file.path(roots[i],b$file),b$sha256)
 groups[[paste(i,id)]]<-n7_purchase_settle(plan,labels,2,.65)
 for(arm in names(plan$arms)) {
  a<-plan$arms[[arm]];e<-a$exposure
  models[[paste(id,arm)]]<-tibble(issue=id,policy=arm,model_hit=a$evaluation$any_hit,
   purchased_groups=length(a$options),
   max_required=if(nrow(e))max(e$required_stake) else 0,
   max_incompatible=if(nrow(e))max(e$incompatible_stake) else 0,
   max_uses=if(nrow(e))max(e$uses) else 0)
 }
}
groups<-bind_rows(groups);models<-bind_rows(models)
rows<-groups |> group_by(issue,policy) |> summarise(stake=sum(stake),gross=sum(gross),hits=sum(hit),.groups='drop')
rows<-models |> left_join(rows,by=c('issue','policy'),relationship='one-to-one') |>
 mutate(across(c(stake,gross,hits),~replace_na(.x,0)),net=gross-stake,model='FROZEN',budget_cny=1024,
 cash_cny=1024-stake,status=ifelse(stake>0,'COMPLETE','NO_BET'),
 stage=case_when(issue<min(cfg$excluded_drawdown_issues)~'BEFORE',issue %in% cfg$excluded_drawdown_issues~'DRAWDOWN',TRUE~'AFTER'))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rows[c('issue','policy')]),all(table(rows$policy)==length(ids)))
stages<-c('BEFORE','DRAWDOWN','AFTER');stages<-stages[stages %in% rows$stage]
comparison<-n7_purchase_accounting(rows,ids,stages,'JOINT',100000)
summary<-comparison$summary
knitr::kable(summary,digits=2)
original_ids<-c(cfg$issues,cfg$excluded_drawdown_issues)
cohort_rows<-rows |> mutate(stage=if_else(issue %in% original_ids,'ORIGINAL','ADDITIONAL'))
cohort_comparison<-n7_purchase_accounting(cohort_rows,ids,unique(cohort_rows$stage),'JOINT',100000)
cohort_summary<-cohort_comparison$summary
knitr::kable(cohort_summary,digits=2)
funding_stops<-summary |> filter(evaluation=='ALL',accounting_basis=='FUNDED',!is.na(funding_stop_issue))
knitr::kable(funding_stops,digits=2)
```

## 收益及回撤曲线

各小图的灰线为同一joint对照，彩色线为该方案；从同一个10万元起点计算。
先展示可支付资金曲线，再展示持续计划的诊断曲线。停投后平坦不是风险消失，而是停止承担新仓位。

```{r}
curves<-comparison$curves |> filter(evaluation=='ALL')
base<-curves |> filter(policy=='JOINT')
plot_curves<-curves |> left_join(base |> select(accounting_basis,period,base_equity=equity_cny,base_drawdown=drawdown_cny),by=c('accounting_basis','period'),relationship='many-to-one')
funded_curves<-plot_curves |> filter(accounting_basis=='FUNDED')
shadow_curves<-plot_curves |> filter(accounting_basis=='SHADOW')
equity_plot<-ggplot(funded_curves,aes(period,equity_cny))+geom_line(aes(y=base_equity),color='grey60')+
 geom_line(color='#206b9b')+facet_wrap(~policy,ncol=3)+theme_minimal()+labs(x='Issue sequence',y='Funded equity (CNY)')
drawdown_plot<-ggplot(funded_curves,aes(period,drawdown_cny))+geom_line(aes(y=base_drawdown),color='grey60')+
 geom_line(color='#b84635')+facet_wrap(~policy,ncol=3)+theme_minimal()+labs(x='Issue sequence',y='Funded drawdown (CNY)')
print(equity_plot);print(drawdown_plot)
shadow_equity_plot<-ggplot(shadow_curves,aes(period,equity_cny))+geom_line(aes(y=base_equity),color='grey60')+
 geom_line(color='#206b9b')+facet_wrap(~policy,ncol=3)+theme_minimal()+labs(x='Issue sequence',y='Shadow equity (CNY; diagnostic only)')
shadow_drawdown_plot<-ggplot(shadow_curves,aes(period,drawdown_cny))+geom_line(aes(y=base_drawdown),color='grey60')+
 geom_line(color='#b84635')+facet_wrap(~policy,ncol=3)+theme_minimal()+labs(x='Issue sequence',y='Shadow drawdown (CNY; diagnostic only)')
print(shadow_equity_plot);print(shadow_drawdown_plot)
key_policies<-c('JOINT','HARD','DEPTH_OPEN','U4','CONFIDENCE')
key_curves<-funded_curves |> filter(policy %in% key_policies) |>
 mutate(policy=factor(policy,levels=key_policies))
key_equity_plot<-ggplot(key_curves,aes(period,equity_cny,color=policy))+
 geom_line(linewidth=.55)+theme_minimal()+
 labs(x='Issue sequence',y='Funded equity (CNY)',color='Policy',
      subtitle='Same CNY 100,000 initial capital; actual spending differs')
key_drawdown_plot<-ggplot(key_curves,aes(period,drawdown_cny,color=policy))+
 geom_line(linewidth=.55)+theme_minimal()+labs(x='Issue sequence',y='Funded drawdown (CNY)',color='Policy')
print(key_equity_plot);print(key_drawdown_plot)
```

## 命中变化、资金利用和集中度

下方敞口与模型命中率描述冻结计划，停投后未执行的计划不计入 FUNDED 收益。cash 为未使用的名义预算，不是向账户补入的现金。

```{r}
knitr::kable(comparison$paired,digits=2)
exposure<-rows |> group_by(policy) |> summarise(issues=n(),mean_stake=mean(stake),cash=sum(cash_cny),
 mean_groups=mean(purchased_groups),mean_model_hit=mean(model_hit),actual_hit=mean(gross>0),
 mean_max_required=mean(max_required),worst_required=max(max_required),
 mean_max_incompatible=mean(max_incompatible),max_fixture_uses=max(max_uses),.groups='drop')
knitr::kable(exposure,digits=3)
```

## 被购买组的概率曲线形态

横轴为按原概率从高到低购买的票数，纵轴为累计概率。线为中位数，带为组间25%—75%分位区间。
这里只描述可支付账本中实际执行的组，不把不同组的形态相似当作风险独立。

```{r}
shapes<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$structure,'shapes.csv'),receipts[[2]]$shape_sha256,
 cols(issue='c',sleeve_id='d'))
funded_groups<-groups |> semi_join(funded_curves |> filter(period>0,!stopped),by=c('issue','policy'))
membership<-funded_groups |> distinct(issue,policy,sleeve_id)
selected_shapes<-membership |> left_join(shapes,by=c('issue','sleeve_id'),relationship='many-to-one')
stopifnot(!anyNA(selected_shapes$mass_64))
profiles<-selected_shapes |> pivot_longer(c(mass_16,mass_32,mass_64,mass_128),names_to='prefix',values_to='mass') |>
 mutate(tickets=as.integer(sub('mass_','',prefix))) |> group_by(policy,tickets) |>
 summarise(groups=n(),median=median(mass),lower=quantile(mass,.25),upper=quantile(mass,.75),.groups='drop')
shape_plot<-ggplot(profiles,aes(tickets,median))+geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper),fill='#206b9b',alpha=.2)+
 geom_line(color='#206b9b')+facet_wrap(~policy,ncol=3)+theme_minimal()+labs(x='Tickets in probability order',y='Cumulative probability')
print(shape_plot)
role_support<-shapes |> count(core_count,middle_count,opportunity_count,name='candidate_groups')
knitr::kable(role_support)
```

## 剔除自身最大盈利期

同时移除该期成本和回款；保留的范围不同，因此这是各方案自身尾部压力检查。
分别检查两个既有账本，不在删除大奖后重新模拟停投状态。

```{r}
trimmed<-list()
for(k in c(1L,3L,5L)) {
 z<-curves |> filter(period>0) |> group_by(accounting_basis,policy) |> arrange(desc(net),issue,.by_group=TRUE) |> filter(row_number()>k) |>
 summarise(remaining_issues=n(),stake=sum(stake),gross=sum(gross),net=gross-stake,
 roi_percent=if(stake>0)100*net/stake else NA_real_,.groups='drop') |> mutate(removed=k)
 trimmed[[as.character(k)]]<-z
}
trimmed<-bind_rows(trimmed);knitr::kable(trimmed,digits=2)
o<-params$output;stopifnot(!dir.exists(o),dir.create(o,recursive=FALSE))
for(n in c('rows','groups','funded_groups','summary','cohort_summary','funding_stops','exposure','trimmed','curves','profiles','role_support','scope_table'))write_csv(get(n),file.path(o,paste0(n,'.csv')))
write_csv(catalog$unavailable_issues,file.path(o,'unavailable_issues.csv'))
write_csv(comparison$paired,file.path(o,'paired.csv'))
ggsave(file.path(o,'equity.png'),equity_plot,width=13,height=16,dpi=160)
ggsave(file.path(o,'drawdown.png'),drawdown_plot,width=13,height=16,dpi=160)
ggsave(file.path(o,'shadow-equity.png'),shadow_equity_plot,width=13,height=16,dpi=160)
ggsave(file.path(o,'shadow-drawdown.png'),shadow_drawdown_plot,width=13,height=16,dpi=160)
ggsave(file.path(o,'key-equity.png'),key_equity_plot,width=11,height=6,dpi=160)
ggsave(file.path(o,'key-drawdown.png'),key_drawdown_plot,width=11,height=6,dpi=160)
ggsave(file.path(o,'shapes.png'),shape_plot,width=13,height=16,dpi=160)
artifacts<-list.files(o,full.names=TRUE)
jsonlite::write_json(list(status='PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW',scope=ids,parent_hashes=hashes,code=code,
 labels_sha256=params$labels_sha256,catalog_sha256=receipts[[1]]$catalog_sha256,
 files=setNames(as.list(vapply(artifacts,digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),basename(artifacts)),
historical_admission=FALSE),file.path(o,'receipt.json'),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
```

## 原484期结论：供新增数据对照

保留 JOINT 作为比较基准。DEPTH_OPEN 在优先分散到不同组后使用剩余资金加深覆盖，
绝对收益有所增加，但投入也更多，ROI 与 JOINT 几乎相同，不能称为显著的资金效率提升。
U4 可作为降低暴露的选择；其较低回撤伴随较低投入，不能解释为同等实际投入下的改进。

不采用本轮的直接深度竞争作为升级：命中期数增加，却出现负收益。
HARD 仅测试原候选组内刚性剔除第三赛果，不代表早先所有 Top2 选场和选胆版本。
相似覆盖成本筛选也未显示优势；这只否定当前定义及当前候选池，不能推及所有曲线选组方法。

区分度复用的拆分对照显示，相对于固定上限，变化主要来自减少低区分度场次的复用。
附加方向金额限制的作用较小，组合方案 ROI 仍低于 JOINT。它目前更接近减仓措施，
尚不是已证实的效率升级。概率区分度也不等同于经过历史校准的可靠性。

CORE3、CORE4 与 STRUCTURE 几乎没有合格投注，证据不足。
这里是在旧候选池上筛选，尚未测试按“核心／中间／机会”构成重新生成七场候选组。
不能将几乎不投注产生的平坦回撤曲线称为成功。

本节文字仅概括原484期的结果，不能代替上方新增期及完整数据表的判断。
全部数据仍属于回顾诊断，不能将这批已被反复研究的样本称为未见测试集。
完整数据的采用结论须在独立结算复核及 Codex review 后确认。
